name: MLP probe
tagline: Single-hidden-layer ReLU MLP head over the delta embedding (mutant - wildtype).
diff_from_baseline: Standard supervised PLM-probing baseline (TAPE; ProteinNPT/ProteinGym). Maps the mutation-induced ESM-2 embedding shift to fitness via one nonlinear hidden layer.

name: Reshape CNN probe
tagline: Reshapes the concatenated [embed, delta] (2560) into a 64x40 'image' and applies residual 1D convs over embedding channels.
diff_from_baseline: Convolutional probe in the classic CNN/MLP/linear baseline triplet. Note: convs run over reshaped embedding dims (no per-residue features available), enforcing weight sharing across channel blocks rather than over a real sequence axis.

name: Ridge head
tagline: Single nn.Linear over the delta embedding, trained end-to-end with AdamW weight_decay=5e-2 (L2 = ridge).
formula: $$\hat y = w^{\top}\,\Delta e + b,\quad \mathcal L = \tfrac{1}{N}\sum_i (y_i-\hat y_i)^2 + \lambda\|w\|_2^2,\;\lambda=5\!\times\!10^{-2}$$
diff_from_baseline: ProteinNPT/ProteinGym 'Embeddings' supervised linear baseline. Linear probe of frozen PLM features under ridge regularization; standard reference for nonlinear protein-fitness heads.
